description: You are a neurologist assessing a brain MRI for possible normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH) in an elderly patient presenting with the classic triad of gait instability, urinary incontinence, and cognitive decline. The MRI is already loaded in Weasis from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/brain_mri_nph/. Perform a standard NPH morphometric assessment: calculate the Evans index from appropriate ventricular and cranial measurements, assess the third ventricle and temporal horns, and determine whether the findings are consistent with ventriculomegaly. Export annotated measurement images to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/evans_index_measurement.png and write a structured neurometrics report to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/nph_assessment_report.txt with all measurements, the calculated Evans index, and your clinical determination.

metadata.clinical_scenario: Normal pressure hydrocephalus assessment with Evans index
